title: First look at Ocean Song Jinx and Soraka in League of Legends Patch 26.17
summary: First look at Ocean Song Jinx and Soraka in League of Legends Patch 26.17  Esports.gg
content:
XC is a long-time player and enjoyer of anything video games, with some tech on the side. He has spent countless hours on MOBAs, single-player RPGs, and competitive shooters. XC's also a massive esports fan.

Jinx and Soraka are joining the Sunkissed Summer skin universe withOcean Song JinxandOcean Song Soraka! These summer-inspired looks will go live on League of Legends Patch 26.17, scheduled for Aug. 26. Read along for a first look at the skins.

A pyrotechnic artist of anarchy, Jinx’s musical inventions skirt the line between entertaining and life-threatening. After three years of the Ocean Song Festival “forgetting” to invite her, Jinx has invited herself, along with her latest bombastic tech. She knows just what the opening night act is missing to make it a truly unforgettable show: chaos.

Ocean Song Jinx is an Epic Skin priced at1350 RP.As such, this skin only comes with newsound and voice effects, animations, and recall, but no unique voicelines and interactions.

After years of success as a vocalist, Soraka felt too removed from the people she sang for and about. A reset was needed, and the Ocean Song Festival offered the right shakeup. Now she’s headlining the opening night and providing backup to any other artists who need it. From now on, if Soraka’s going to sing, she’s also going to help others be heard.

Ocean Song Soraka is an Epic Skin priced at1350 RP. Like Ocean Song Jinx, she has new SFX and VFX, animations, and recall, but will use the same voicelines and interactions as her base form.
